gb.title: Inaugural $10 million Department of War grant will enhance defense research capacity at N.C. A&T
gb.description: Funding will be spent on research project into AI, cyber resilience and quantum systems linked to national security Inaugural DoW grant will fund cutting-edge research in STEM fields aligned with national security The U.S. Department of War has named North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University an inaugural recipient of a five-year, $10 million grant to establish Accelerate-DAQ, a project focused on expanding the institutions defence research capacity in artificial intelligence, autonomy, cyber resilience and quantum systems. The project is funded through the Department of War Historically Black Colleges and Universities and Minority-Serving Institutions (HBCU/MI) Program within the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering, which established the pilot program to increase research capacity at HBCUs and other MIs. The DoW established the program to provide support for cutting-edge research and training at HBCUs and MIs in many STEM fields aligned with national security. The scale of investment will serve to accelerate progress of the research enterprise itself while supporting specific research projects. For A&T, that includes reaching and sustaining Research 1 status in the Carnegie Classification of Institutions of Higher Education. A validation of A&T research Chancellor James R. Martin II said: “We’re honored to have been chosen for the Accelerate-DAQ program. Our selection is strong validation of the research A&T is already focused on and our capacity to do much more in the future. “Some of the most important research of the past 50 years has been funded by DoW/Department of Defense funding, including major advances in drug development, materials science, human augmentation technology and more. Accelerate-DAQ will enable A&T to make larger contributions toward advancing science and solving new and emerging scientific challenges.” Accelerate-DAQ will focus on several of the six DoW’s Critical Technology Areas (CTAs) , with a particular emphasis on Applied Artificial Intelligence (AAI) and Quantum and Battlefield Information Dominance, with three interconnected research clusters: Trustworthy AI & Cyber Defense, AI-enabled Autonomy, and Quantum Computing. “Future AI systems must do more than produce accurate answers. They must be trustworthy, resilient and capable of operating under uncertainty,” said Kaushik Roy, Ph.D., one of the project’s faculty leads and Computer Science department chair in A&T’s College of Engineering. “Our research explores how intelligent systems can collaborate effectively with people, resist cyber threats and continue making reliable decisions in challenging environments. These advances have the potential to reshape how humans and AI work together in applications that demand both performance and trust.” Enhanced research culture The Accelerate-DAQ project also seeks to enhance the research culture across campus, and will empower ‘research champions’ within the faculty, postdoctoral scholars, graduate and undergraduate students, and research staff. It will also increase A&T capacity to do research in sensitive or classified areas. “This project is a gamechanger in developing and providing support for our research champions at every level in multiple disciplines, while strengthening A&T’s ability to meet national security demands,” said Lisa Clough, Ph.D., vice chancellor for Research at A&T and Accelerate-DAQ lead principal investigator. “We must continue investing in emerging STEM scholars, helping them thrive as scientists and embrace excellence in research.”

es.description: Cristina Taverner, vicerrectora de Formación Continua de la UVic-UCC y decana de Elisava durante el curso 2025-26, y Marta González, actual decana del centro, reivindican el diseño como una herramienta para transformar la industria y la sociedad. Frente a la aceleración tecnológica, defienden una formación capaz de combinar creatividad, investigación y oficio. Opinan que la universidad debe ser un punto de encuentro entre talento, investigación y empresa. Ya no basta con formar buenos profesionales: se necesitan personas capaces de entender los problemas complejos, innovar y generar impacto. La investigación, además, debe estar conectada con las necesidades reales de la sociedad y de la industria. Y en este contexto, Catalunya tiene un enorme potencial creativo. El reto es conseguir que ese talento crezca aquí, se conecte con el tejido productivo y tenga proyección internacional, un objetivo al que Elisava busca contribuir combinando creatividad, tecnología, pensamiento crítico y una mirada humanista.

Ο πόλεμος στο Ιράν έχει κοστίσει ήδη 38 δισ. δολάρια στις ΗΠΑ -Πόσο αυξάνεται κάθε μήνα ο λογαριασμός
gr.description: Ο πόλεμος εναντίον του Ιράν έχει κοστίσει στο κράτος των ΗΠΑ 38 δισεκατομμύρια δολάρια από την έναρξή του. Αυτό ανέφερε χθες Τρίτη η υπηρεσία του Κογκρέσου για τον προϋπολογισμό (CBO), όργανο χωρίς κομματικό πρόσημο, οι υπολογισμοί της οποίας καλύπτουν την περίοδο ως και τον Αύγουστο. Το κόστος συνεχίζει να αυξάνεται Η CBO προειδοποίησε ότι ακόμη κι αν η ένταση της ένοπλης σύγκρουσης μειωθεί, ο λογαριασμός θα συνεχίσει να αυξάνεται κατά δύο δισεκατομμύρια δολάρια τον μήνα. Σε περίπτωση κλιμάκωσής της, που σημειώθηκε τις τελευταίες εβδομάδες, το κόστος θα αυξάνεται κατά 3 δισεκ. δολάρια τον μήνα. Το κόστος αυτό συμπεριλαμβάνει, μεταξύ άλλων, τα πυρομαχικά και τον εξοπλισμό που χρησιμοποιούνται στις μάχες, αλλά και τις δαπάνες, που μεγεθύνονται, για τα καύσιμα που καταναλώνουν οι αμερικανικές ένοπλες δυνάμεις. Σύμφωνα με τους υπολογισμούς της υπηρεσίας, μόνο η δαπάνη για την αναπλήρωση των πυρομαχικών που αναλώθηκαν στον πόλεμο, που άρχισε την 28η Φεβρουαρίου, θα ανέλθει σε 21,7 δισεκ. δολάρια. Ανησυχία για τα αποθέματα πυραύλων Η CBO εκφράζει εξάλλου ανησυχία για την μείωση των αποθεμάτων των πυραύλων αναχαίτισης. Συγκρίνοντας τις δαπάνες για τους πυραύλους αυτούς με τον συνολικό αριθμό τους που έχει αγοραστεί, οι ΗΠΑ «πιθανόν χρησιμοποίησαν από το μισό ως τα δυο τρίτα των αποθεμάτων τους από τον Ιούνιο του 2025», σημείωσε. Προχθές Δευτέρα, έκθεση του γενικού επιθεωρητή του Πενταγώνου επιβεβαίωσε ότι παρατηρούνται «ελλείψεις» πυρομαχικών εξαιτίας του πολέμου στο Ιράν, διαπίστωση που η κυβέρνηση του προέδρου των ΗΠΑ Ντόναλντ Τραμπ αρνείται κατηγορηματικά τους τελευταίους μήνες. Η ανάλυση της CBO έγινε κατόπιν αιτήματος δημοκρατικών κοινοβουλευτικών. Τον Ιούλιο, ο υπουργός Πολέμου Πιτ Χέγκσεθ δήλωνε ότι το κόστος του πολέμου ανερχόταν σε 37,5 δισεκ. δολάρια. Επιπτώσεις στον πληθωρισμό Η CBO εκτιμά εξάλλου ότι ο πόλεμος στο Ιράν θα έχει επίπτωση στον πληθωρισμό στις ΗΠΑ, κυρίως εξαιτίας των διαταράξεων που προκαλεί στον εφοδιασμό με πετρέλαιο και αέριο. Από το ξέσπασμα του πολέμου, η Τεχεράνη έκλεισε το στενό του Ορμούζ, θαλάσσια οδό στρατηγικής σημασίας για το παγκόσμιο εμπόριο υδρογονανθράκων. Βασιζόμενη στον δείκτη PCE, η υπηρεσία προϋπολογισμού ανέβασε την πρόβλεψή της για τον πληθωρισμό το πρώτο τρίμηνο του 2027 κατά 0,5 μονάδα σε σύγκριση με τον Φεβρουάριο. Η πρόβλεψή της που αφορά τον υποκείμενο πληθωρισμό —σ.σ. ή αλλιώς «δομικό πληθωρισμό», εξαιρουμένων των ευμετάβλητων τιμών της ενέργειας και των τροφίμων— επίσης αναθεωρήθηκε προς τα πάνω, κατά 0,3%. Η αύξηση του πληθωρισμού θα επιφέρει επίσης αύξηση των επιτοκίων δανεισμού, ανέφερε ακόμη η CBO. Επίδομα 400 ευρώ: Πότε πληρώνεται, ποιοι συνταξιούχοι το δικαιούνται
gr.description: Η έκτακτη παροχή δεν επηρεάζει το ποσό της κύριας ή της επικουρικής σύνταξης, καθώς πρόκειται για ξεχωριστή καταβολή που πραγματοποιείται μία φορά. Στις 30 Νοεμβρίου έχει προγραμματιστεί η εφάπαξ καταβολή οικονομικής ενίσχυσης ύψους 400 ευρώ σε συνολικά 2.197.000 συνταξιούχους. Η ενίσχυση θα καταβληθεί χωρίς εισοδηματικά κριτήρια, ενώ οι δικαιούχοι δεν χρειάζεται να υποβάλουν ξεχωριστή αίτηση. Η πληρωμή θα γίνει ηλεκτρονικά, με τα ποσά να πιστώνονται απευθείας στους τραπεζικούς λογαριασμούς των δικαιούχων, βάσει των στοιχείων που διαθέτουν οι αρμόδιες υπηρεσίες. Η εμφάνιση των χρημάτων στους λογαριασμούς ενδέχεται να διαφέρει ανάλογα με την τράπεζα και τον χρόνο ολοκλήρωσης των συναλλαγών. Το ποσό ανέρχεται σε 400 ευρώ ανά δικαιούχο. Εφόσον η ενίσχυση καταβληθεί στο σύνολο των 2.197.000 δικαιούχων, η συνολική δαπάνη διαμορφώνεται περίπου στα 878,8 εκατ. ευρώ. Χωρίς εισοδηματικά κριτήρια Βασικό χαρακτηριστικό της παροχής είναι ότι δεν συνδέεται με το ύψος του εισοδήματος. Επομένως, οι συνταξιούχοι που πληρούν τις προβλεπόμενες προϋποθέσεις δεν αποκλείονται από την ενίσχυση λόγω υψηλότερου εισοδήματος. Τα 400 ευρώ αποτελούν αυτοτελή, εφάπαξ οικονομική ενίσχυση και δεν ενσωματώνονται στη μηνιαία σύνταξη ούτε συνιστούν μόνιμη αύξησή της. Την ενίσχυση δικαιούνται οι συνταξιούχοι άνω των 65 ετών, χωρίς επιπλέον εισοδηματικά ή περιουσιακά κριτήρια, σύμφωνα με τις προβλεπόμενες προϋποθέσεις. Το ίδιο ποσό προβλέπεται και για συνταξιούχους άνω των 60 ετών που λαμβάνουν αποκλειστικά σύνταξη λόγω θανάτου (χηρείας), καθώς και για άτομα με αναπηρία ανεξαρτήτως ηλικίας και ανασφάλιστους υπερήλικες του ΟΠΕΚΑ. Η έκτακτη παροχή δεν επηρεάζει το ποσό της κύριας ή της επικουρικής σύνταξης, καθώς πρόκειται για ξεχωριστή καταβολή που πραγματοποιείται μία φορά. Με βάση τον προγραμματισμό, λοιπόν, στις 30 Νοεμβρίου ξεκινά η καταβολή των 400 ευρώ στους συνολικά 2.197.000 δικαιούχους. Η ενίσχυση θα καταβληθεί εφάπαξ, χωρίς εισοδηματικά κριτήρια και χωρίς να απαιτείται ξεχωριστή διαδικασία από τους δικαιούχους, εφόσον πληρούν τις προβλεπόμενες προϋποθέσεις. #ΣΥΝΤΑΞΙΟΥΧΟΙ #400_ΕΥΡΩ #ΕΠΙΔΟΜΑ_400_ΕΥΡΩ #ΠΛΗΡΩΜΗ

co.description: Authored by juanmarcoantoniorp Image La Opinión Miércoles, 16 de Septiembre de 2026 Con el propósito de prevenir el consumo de sustancias psicoactivas entre los menores de edad y fortalecer su seguridad, diferentes dependencias de la Alcaldía de Cúcuta han venido adelantando jornadas integrales de prevención, pedagogía y control urbano en instituciones educativas de la ciudad. Entre las instituciones priorizadas se encuentran aquellas con una gran cantidad de estudiantes y las ubicadas en zonas afectadas por la venta y el consumo de estupefacientes. De este modo, las secretarías de Gobierno, Educación y Seguridad, junto con la Policía Nacional y el Instituto Colombiano de Bienestar Familiar (ICBF), han desarrollado una oferta integral que incluye acciones de control urbano, campañas de prevención del consumo de sustancias psicoactivas, actividades pedagógicas, vigilancia comunitaria y acompañamiento psicosocial . “Estas jornadas se hacen por lo menos dos veces al mes, con el objetivo de identificar esos factores de riesgo y generar herramientas que permitan a los estudiantes tomar decisiones responsables y fortalecer sus proyectos de vida”, explicó la Alcaldía de Cúcuta. En este sentido, la Secretaría de Educación municipal detalló que la Policía se encarga de realizar requisas en las entradas de las instituciones, mientras que las demás entidades desarrollan las charlas de prevención al interior de los recintos, informando sobre las consecuencias del consumo de sustancias psicoactivas e invitando a los jóvenes a denunciar estos casos. Por su parte, la Secretaría de Gobierno de Cúcuta indicó que su objetivo es que estas intervenciones no se limiten a acciones de control, sino que incorporen un componente preventivo y pedagógico que permita acercar la institucionalidad a los jóvenes , escuchar sus necesidades y promover espacios de convivencia. Además, la Administración Municipal anunció que continuará promoviendo estrategias integrales que involucren a estudiantes, docentes, padres de familia, autoridades y comunidad, con el propósito de construir instituciones educativas más seguras y espacios que favorezcan el desarrollo integral de niños, niñas y adolescentes . “Con estas jornadas ya hemos logrado llegar a alrededor de 20.000 estudiantes en la ciudad . Es importante destacar que el trabajo articulado con las comunidades educativas permitirá seguir fortaleciendo la identificación temprana de situaciones que puedan afectar la seguridad y la convivencia en los entornos escolares y promover una respuesta oportuna por parte de las autoridades y las entidades competentes”, concluyó la Alcaldía. sg.title: PAINSTUDY Inc. Expands Functional Patch Lineup for Everyday Muscle and Joint Care
sg.description: Functional healthcare brand builds on domestic online market experience to broaden product lineup, distribution channels, and eye global wellness market entry SEOUL, South Korea , Sept. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Functional healthcare brand PAINSTUDY Inc. is strengthening its product competitiveness with the launch of a new line of functional patches aimed at meeting the everyday muscle and joint care needs of modern consumers. Drawing on consumer feedback and product development know-how accumulated in the domestic online market, the company plans to expand both its product lineup and distribution channels, with an eye toward eventually entering the global wellness market. PAINSTUDY is a brand that develops and supplies functional healthcare products designed to help modern consumers manage their physical condition more easily amid everyday muscle and joint discomfort. By analyzing contemporary lifestyle patterns and usage environments, the company has developed premium muscle and joint patches in-house with an emphasis on safety and ease of use. Its core product line takes the form of skin-adhesive patches, designed with an emphasis on adhesion and usability so they can be conveniently applied during daily activities. The new product line reflects customer feedback the company has gathered through its sales history, as well as its own in-house development know-how. Rather than simply adding new items, the development process focused on incorporating the real, everyday inconveniences and needs voiced by consumers, aiming to deliver a more practical muscle and joint care experience. In particular, PAINSTUDY set a core direction for the new products around helping consumers manage everyday muscle and joint fatigue more economically and efficiently. The company focused on enhancing safety and adhesion by using rigorously quality-controlled ingredients alongside ergonomic design. Another key feature is ease of use — consumers can simply apply the patch to the area they need without any complicated steps. As consumer interest in health management has recently shifted from treatment-oriented approaches toward everyday prevention and self-care, healthcare products that can be conveniently used in daily settings such as the home or workplace have grown in importance. In step with this shift, PAINSTUDY plans to continue developing products that allow consumers to manage their own condition. Alongside product development, the company is also expanding its distribution channels. PAINSTUDY has built its consumer base primarily through major domestic e-commerce platforms such as Coupang and Naver Smart Store. With the launch of its new products, the company plans to leverage the experience gained through its existing online sales channels to expand into a variety of offline distribution channels as well, improving consumer access to its products. Over the longer term, PAINSTUDY aims to expand its product portfolio — which began with muscle and joint patches — into a wider range of healthcare categories. The company plans to continuously gather feedback from actual users to inform future product development, with the goal of growing into a comprehensive wellness brand that supports consumers' everyday health management. The company is also pursuing global market entry. Building on the product development and consumer communication experience it has accumulated in the domestic market, PAINSTUDY plans to seek opportunities to introduce its brand overseas. In particular, as global interest in convenient health management and wellness continues to grow, the company intends to gradually introduce its product competitiveness to consumers abroad. "This new product line is the result of the diverse feedback we've gathered through ongoing communication with our customers, combined with our own in-house product development know-how," a PAINSTUDY Inc. representative said. "We will continue to expand our online and offline distribution channels domestically, while also developing follow-up healthcare products and pursuing overseas expansion, to grow into a comprehensive wellness brand that supports consumers' everyday health management."

sg.title: Xpansiv to Acquire Formbay, Australia's AI-Enabled Renewable Energy Certificate and Compliance Technology Platform
sg.description: Acquisition strengthens Xpansiv's position in global electricity and environmental markets SYDNEY , Sept. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Xpansiv, the leading infrastructure provider for the global energy transition markets, announced it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Formbay, an Australian company that creates, validates, and trades the certificates issued to support a significant portion of the country's fast-growing rooftop solar and home battery installations. Formbay operates Australia's leading electrification and AI-enabled compliance platform for renewable energy certificates, which is used by retailers, installers, and other market participants to verify installations and manage compliance and payments across solar, batteries, and energy efficiency programs. Supporting around one-quarter of the country's Small-scale Technology Certificates (STCs), its systems create almost 100,000 certificates per day or more than 25 million per year, facilitating more than AUD $1 billion in certificate transactions in 2025. The company works with nearly 30,000 registered retailers and installers, handling one in three home solar installations nationally. Xpansiv brings deep experience in renewable energy certificate (REC) markets globally, providing neutral market infrastructure that supports market participants. The company facilitates the creation, management, and monetization of RECs for both distributed and large-scale energy resources, with more than 320 GW of renewable generation capacity registered across more than 60 countries. "Australia has one of the highest rates of rooftop solar in the world, a mature set of small-scale certificate schemes, and a home battery market that is growing rapidly," said John Melby, CEO, Xpansiv. "As a major renewable energy facilitator, we see Formbay as a natural fit within our platform. This acquisition is an important step in our strategy of uniting key energy and environmental market infrastructure in a single global platform." Formbay has developed advanced AI-enabled verification and workflow technologies that help automate the validation of renewable energy assets and certificate creation processes. Combined with Xpansiv's AI-enabled registry, market infrastructure, and data solutions, these capabilities create opportunities to accelerate verification, improve auditability, reduce administrative costs, and scale environmental markets more efficiently. "Formbay has been built alongside Australia's solar and renewable energy industry over more than a decade, and protecting the trust of our retailers and installers has always been incredibly important to us," said Dan Sullivan, Founder and CEO of Formbay. "As we've considered opportunities to grow Formbay, we have been very deliberate about finding the right partner. Xpansiv understands certificate markets, regulators, market participants and, importantly, the technology required to make these markets work at scale. They give Formbay the platform and resources to continue investing in our Australian customers while taking the technology and expertise we've developed here into renewable energy markets around the world. For our customers, this is about a stronger Formbay and the opportunity for us to take them on that journey with us." "The acquisition will unite Xpansiv and Formbay, two Australian-born companies that have built critical infrastructure to scale and accelerate the global energy transition," said Nathan Rockliff, Chief Strategy Officer, Xpansiv, who co-founded the company with Ben Stuart in 2009. "We are excited to advance our global electricity markets presence and significant AI capabilities with Formbay's deep portfolio of proprietary IP, including production-grade AI capabilities. Across Xpansiv, we are increasingly applying AI and automation to solve complex verification, compliance, registry, and multi-party workflow challenges. Formbay brings proven AI capabilities operating at scale in Australia's electrification market, providing a platform we can extend across energy and environmental markets globally." The combination will create new opportunities across Xpansiv's global platform. Formbay customers will benefit from access to Xpansiv's global market infrastructure and deep market expertise, while Formbay's technology and certificate capabilities can be extended into additional products and markets over time. The acquisition will further broaden Xpansiv's strong and growing position in global electricity markets. Around 4% of total global electricity generation and 7% of renewable energy generation are managed through the Xpansiv platform, and about 28% of renewable energy certificates issued globally in 2025 are on its registry network. For Formbay customers, there are no changes planned to day-to-day operations, platform access, pricing, or existing customer relationships. Formbay will continue to operate as the trusted technology and certificate partner to its retailers and installers, now with the backing of a well-capitalized global company and greater resources to invest in technology, customer experience, and new products. Formbay will be Xpansiv's 13th acquisition since 2017, and reflects its longstanding strategy to grow organically and through acquisitions with the goal of building a comprehensive infrastructure platform to support the global energy transition. The acquisition is expected to be immediately accretive to Xpansiv's Adjusted EBITDA upon closing. The acquisition, which is subject to regulatory approval, is expected to close later this year. About Xpansiv Xpansiv is the leading infrastructure provider for the energy transition markets. The company's comprehensive platform includes registries, online marketplaces, market execution services, wholesale power solutions, and market data for energy and environmental commodity markets. Trusted worldwide, Xpansiv helps market participants capture opportunities and drive environmental impact. Xpansiv provides solutions that enable stakeholders to deliver transparent, credible, and auditable environmental claims to address the growing global demand for assurance and accountability on climate action and sustainability performance. Company investors include Blackstone Group, Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, Aramco Ventures, Macquarie Group Ltd., S&P Global Ventures, Aware Super, BP Ventures, and Commonwealth Bank. To learn more about Xpansiv, visit xpansiv.com About Formbay Formbay is an Australian technology platform providing critical infrastructure for renewable energy certificate creation, compliance, field documentation and asset verification. Its platform enables solar retailers, installers, renewable energy businesses and market participants to efficiently navigate Australia's renewable energy incentive schemes. By digitising the collection of field data, customer documentation and compliance evidence, Formbay streamlines the process from installation through to verification, certificate creation and submission. Formbay's technology is designed to improve the accuracy, efficiency and integrity of renewable energy programs while reducing the administrative burden on industry participants. Its growing capabilities extend beyond certificate origination into broader asset verification and lifecycle assurance. To learn more about Formbay, visit formbay.com.au

bd.title: PAINSTUDY Inc. Expands Functional Patch Lineup for Everyday Muscle and Joint Care
bd.description: Functional healthcare brand builds on domestic online market experience to broaden product lineup, distribution channels, and eye global wellness market entry SEOUL, South Korea , Sept. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Functional healthcare brand PAINSTUDY Inc. is strengthening its product competitiveness with the launch of a new line of functional patches aimed at meeting the everyday muscle and joint care needs of modern consumers. Drawing on consumer feedback and product development know-how accumulated in the domestic online market, the company plans to expand both its product lineup and distribution channels, with an eye toward eventually entering the global wellness market. PAINSTUDY is a brand that develops and supplies functional healthcare products designed to help modern consumers manage their physical condition more easily amid everyday muscle and joint discomfort. By analyzing contemporary lifestyle patterns and usage environments, the company has developed premium muscle and joint patches in-house with an emphasis on safety and ease of use. Its core product line takes the form of skin-adhesive patches, designed with an emphasis on adhesion and usability so they can be conveniently applied during daily activities. The new product line reflects customer feedback the company has gathered through its sales history, as well as its own in-house development know-how. Rather than simply adding new items, the development process focused on incorporating the real, everyday inconveniences and needs voiced by consumers, aiming to deliver a more practical muscle and joint care experience. In particular, PAINSTUDY set a core direction for the new products around helping consumers manage everyday muscle and joint fatigue more economically and efficiently. The company focused on enhancing safety and adhesion by using rigorously quality-controlled ingredients alongside ergonomic design. Another key feature is ease of use — consumers can simply apply the patch to the area they need without any complicated steps. As consumer interest in health management has recently shifted from treatment-oriented approaches toward everyday prevention and self-care, healthcare products that can be conveniently used in daily settings such as the home or workplace have grown in importance. In step with this shift, PAINSTUDY plans to continue developing products that allow consumers to manage their own condition. Alongside product development, the company is also expanding its distribution channels. PAINSTUDY has built its consumer base primarily through major domestic e-commerce platforms such as Coupang and Naver Smart Store. With the launch of its new products, the company plans to leverage the experience gained through its existing online sales channels to expand into a variety of offline distribution channels as well, improving consumer access to its products. Over the longer term, PAINSTUDY aims to expand its product portfolio — which began with muscle and joint patches — into a wider range of healthcare categories. The company plans to continuously gather feedback from actual users to inform future product development, with the goal of growing into a comprehensive wellness brand that supports consumers' everyday health management. The company is also pursuing global market entry. Building on the product development and consumer communication experience it has accumulated in the domestic market, PAINSTUDY plans to seek opportunities to introduce its brand overseas. In particular, as global interest in convenient health management and wellness continues to grow, the company intends to gradually introduce its product competitiveness to consumers abroad. "This new product line is the result of the diverse feedback we've gathered through ongoing communication with our customers, combined with our own in-house product development know-how," a PAINSTUDY Inc. representative said. "We will continue to expand our online and offline distribution channels domestically, while also developing follow-up healthcare products and pursuing overseas expansion, to grow into a comprehensive wellness brand that supports consumers' everyday health management."

bd.title: Xpansiv to Acquire Formbay, Australia's AI-Enabled Renewable Energy Certificate and Compliance Technology Platform
bd.description: Acquisition strengthens Xpansiv's position in global electricity and environmental markets SYDNEY , Sept. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Xpansiv, the leading infrastructure provider for the global energy transition markets, announced it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Formbay, an Australian company that creates, validates, and trades the certificates issued to support a significant portion of the country's fast-growing rooftop solar and home battery installations. Formbay operates Australia's leading electrification and AI-enabled compliance platform for renewable energy certificates, which is used by retailers, installers, and other market participants to verify installations and manage compliance and payments across solar, batteries, and energy efficiency programs. Supporting around one-quarter of the country's Small-scale Technology Certificates (STCs), its systems create almost 100,000 certificates per day or more than 25 million per year, facilitating more than AUD $1 billion in certificate transactions in 2025. The company works with nearly 30,000 registered retailers and installers, handling one in three home solar installations nationally. Xpansiv brings deep experience in renewable energy certificate (REC) markets globally, providing neutral market infrastructure that supports market participants. The company facilitates the creation, management, and monetization of RECs for both distributed and large-scale energy resources, with more than 320 GW of renewable generation capacity registered across more than 60 countries. "Australia has one of the highest rates of rooftop solar in the world, a mature set of small-scale certificate schemes, and a home battery market that is growing rapidly," said John Melby, CEO, Xpansiv. "As a major renewable energy facilitator, we see Formbay as a natural fit within our platform. This acquisition is an important step in our strategy of uniting key energy and environmental market infrastructure in a single global platform." Formbay has developed advanced AI-enabled verification and workflow technologies that help automate the validation of renewable energy assets and certificate creation processes. Combined with Xpansiv's AI-enabled registry, market infrastructure, and data solutions, these capabilities create opportunities to accelerate verification, improve auditability, reduce administrative costs, and scale environmental markets more efficiently. "Formbay has been built alongside Australia's solar and renewable energy industry over more than a decade, and protecting the trust of our retailers and installers has always been incredibly important to us," said Dan Sullivan, Founder and CEO of Formbay. "As we've considered opportunities to grow Formbay, we have been very deliberate about finding the right partner. Xpansiv understands certificate markets, regulators, market participants and, importantly, the technology required to make these markets work at scale. They give Formbay the platform and resources to continue investing in our Australian customers while taking the technology and expertise we've developed here into renewable energy markets around the world. For our customers, this is about a stronger Formbay and the opportunity for us to take them on that journey with us." "The acquisition will unite Xpansiv and Formbay, two Australian-born companies that have built critical infrastructure to scale and accelerate the global energy transition," said Nathan Rockliff, Chief Strategy Officer, Xpansiv, who co-founded the company with Ben Stuart in 2009. "We are excited to advance our global electricity markets presence and significant AI capabilities with Formbay's deep portfolio of proprietary IP, including production-grade AI capabilities. Across Xpansiv, we are increasingly applying AI and automation to solve complex verification, compliance, registry, and multi-party workflow challenges. Formbay brings proven AI capabilities operating at scale in Australia's electrification market, providing a platform we can extend across energy and environmental markets globally." The combination will create new opportunities across Xpansiv's global platform. Formbay customers will benefit from access to Xpansiv's global market infrastructure and deep market expertise, while Formbay's technology and certificate capabilities can be extended into additional products and markets over time. The acquisition will further broaden Xpansiv's strong and growing position in global electricity markets. Around 4% of total global electricity generation and 7% of renewable energy generation are managed through the Xpansiv platform, and about 28% of renewable energy certificates issued globally in 2025 are on its registry network. For Formbay customers, there are no changes planned to day-to-day operations, platform access, pricing, or existing customer relationships. Formbay will continue to operate as the trusted technology and certificate partner to its retailers and installers, now with the backing of a well-capitalized global company and greater resources to invest in technology, customer experience, and new products. Formbay will be Xpansiv's 13th acquisition since 2017, and reflects its longstanding strategy to grow organically and through acquisitions with the goal of building a comprehensive infrastructure platform to support the global energy transition. The acquisition is expected to be immediately accretive to Xpansiv's Adjusted EBITDA upon closing. The acquisition, which is subject to regulatory approval, is expected to close later this year. About Xpansiv Xpansiv is the leading infrastructure provider for the energy transition markets. The company's comprehensive platform includes registries, online marketplaces, market execution services, wholesale power solutions, and market data for energy and environmental commodity markets. Trusted worldwide, Xpansiv helps market participants capture opportunities and drive environmental impact. Xpansiv provides solutions that enable stakeholders to deliver transparent, credible, and auditable environmental claims to address the growing global demand for assurance and accountability on climate action and sustainability performance. Company investors include Blackstone Group, Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, Aramco Ventures, Macquarie Group Ltd., S&P Global Ventures, Aware Super, BP Ventures, and Commonwealth Bank. To learn more about Xpansiv, visit xpansiv.com About Formbay Formbay is an Australian technology platform providing critical infrastructure for renewable energy certificate creation, compliance, field documentation and asset verification. Its platform enables solar retailers, installers, renewable energy businesses and market participants to efficiently navigate Australia's renewable energy incentive schemes. By digitising the collection of field data, customer documentation and compliance evidence, Formbay streamlines the process from installation through to verification, certificate creation and submission. Formbay's technology is designed to improve the accuracy, efficiency and integrity of renewable energy programs while reducing the administrative burden on industry participants. Its growing capabilities extend beyond certificate origination into broader asset verification and lifecycle assurance. To learn more about Formbay, visit formbay.com.au

mg.title: ENSEIGNEMENT - Le nouveau programme d’Histoire déplace la période coloniale
mg.description: Le nouveau programme scolaire introduit plusieurs modifications dans l’enseignement de l’Histoire. Parmi les principaux changements figure le déplacement de certains chapitres consacrés à l’histoire de Madagascar d’un niveau de classe à un autre. Des élèves d’une école publique lors de la rentrée scolaire. À partir de cette année scolaire, l’histoire coloniale n’est plus enseignée en classe de troisième au collège ni en classe de première au lycée. Cette période reste toutefois inscrite au programme. « Cependant, cette thématique n’est pas totalement rayée de l’enseignement. Elle est toujours enseignée en classe de quatrième dans le nouveau programme », assure Rija R., enseignant en Histoire dans un établissement scolaire public à Antananarivo. L’information a été confirmée par une source auprès du ministère de l’Éducation nationale, qui n’a toutefois pas été en mesure de préciser les raisons de cette réorganisation. Nous n’avons pas non plus pu joindre la personne à l’origine de cette modification. Selon la répartition annuelle du programme d’études 2026-2027, les élèves de quatrième étudieront désormais plusieurs périodes de l’Histoire de Madagascar, notamment les royaumes malgaches du XVe au XIXe siècle, le royaume de Madagascar de 1810 à 1896, la période coloniale de 1895 à 1960, ainsi que les patrimoines culturels et historiques du pays. En classe de troisième, le programme porte notamment sur Madagascar sous les différentes Républiques, ainsi que sur la commémoration et la célébration des mémoires collectives. Importance En classe de première, la leçon consacrée à la colonisation de Madagascar a été remplacée par un chapitre sur l’Histoire de la photographie. « Ce nouveau chapitre se concentre sur l’arrivée de la photographie à Madagascar, liée à la mission civilisatrice des chrétiens. À mon avis, ce chapitre a été introduit afin d’étudier l’arrivée de cette technologie chez nous ainsi que son impact sur le récit historique », indique Rija R. Pour l’enseignant, l’histoire de la colonisation comme celle de la photographie conservent toutes deux leur importance dans la formation des élèves. « Elles permettent aux élèves d’approfondir l’histoire et de faire leurs propres recherches.» Interrogés sur les conséquences de ce changement, des enseignants estiment que cette nouvelle répartition ne devrait pas affecter les connaissances attendues des élèves. « Ce qu’ils ont appris en classe inférieure reste un acquis pour les classes supérieures », explique un enseignant de la discipline. Un historien de l’Université d’Antananarivo rappelle, pour sa part, qu’un même chapitre n’a pas nécessairement vocation à être repris à plusieurs niveaux. Il souligne également l’intérêt d’intégrer l’art et l’image à l’enseignement de l’Histoire. « Parfois, nous ne mesurons pas l’importance de l’art, alors même que les images préservent notre culture : ce sont des archives vivantes », souligne-t-il. Miangaly Ralitera

mg.title: LIMITATION DE TONNAGE - Le transport de sable sous contrainte à Antsiranana
mg.description: La limitation du tonnage sur la RNT 59B suscite des inquiétudes chez les transporteurs de sable. La mesure pourrait entraîner une baisse de l’offre et une hausse des coûts dans la construction. Rares son les véhicules transportant le sable sur l’axe Ramena qui respectent la limitation. La décision ministérielle limitant provisoirement le poids total en charge des véhicules circulant sur la Route nationale temporaire (RNT 59B), entre la ville d’Antsiranana et la commune rurale de Ramena, suscite des réactions parmi les transporteurs de la ville d’Antsiranana. À l’origine de ces préoccupations, une lettre de transmission référencée n° 309, en date du 2 septembre, portant sur cette limitation. Afin de prévenir une dégradation prématurée de la route et de ses infrastructures, et dans l’attente de la publication et de l’application du texte réglementaire qui devra fixer officiellement le poids maximal autorisé sur cet axe, des mesures provisoires ont été prises. Les propriétaires et conducteurs de poids lourds spécialisés dans le transport de sable au départ de la commune de Ramena se sentent particulièrement concernés par cette nouvelle mesure. Pour eux, cette limitation constitue une contrainte importante pour leur activité et pourrait perturber l’approvisionnement de la ville d’Antsiranana. Le sable constituant une matière première essentielle pour les travaux de construction, la réduction des volumes transportés pourrait entraîner des tensions sur le marché. La limitation du tonnage alimente ainsi les discussions autour du transport de sable à Antsiranana. Pour le ministère des Travaux publics, l’objectif est avant tout de prévenir une dégradation prématurée de la route et de ses infrastructures. La circulation répétée de poids lourds transportant des charges supérieures à la capacité de la route pourrait accélérer la détérioration de la chaussée et des ouvrages qui jalonnent cet axe. Des opérations de pesage et de contrôle peuvent également être effectuées sur les sites jugés appropriés. De leur côté, les transporteurs, vendeurs et acteurs du bâtiment redoutent une baisse de l’approvisionnement, une multiplication des rotations et, à terme, une hausse des prix. Des répercussions sur le marché Si la mesure vise à protéger la route, ses conséquences commencent à se faire sentir sur l’activité des transporteurs. Toute perturbation de l’approvisionnement peut avoir des répercussions sur le secteur de la construction. Pour les transporteurs, moins de sable transporté par voyage signifie davantage de rotations pour satisfaire la même demande. Un transporteur estime ainsi que le prix du sable livré dans la ville pourrait dépasser son prix actuel de 30 000 ariary, en raison notamment de l’augmentation des charges liées aux rotations supplémentaires. Selon des professionnels du secteur, le nombre de camions capables de respecter la nouvelle limitation serait par ailleurs insuffisant pour répondre à la demande actuelle. Face aux difficultés rencontrées, plusieurs réunions se succèdent avec les différentes parties prenantes, sans qu’une solution consensuelle ne semble encore émerger. La question du poids réel des camions constitue également un sujet de discussion entre transporteurs. Les fiches techniques des véhicules et leurs capacités de chargement font l’objet de débats, voire de contestations. Certains professionnels évoquent également l’existence de possibles conflits d’intérêts entre opérateurs. Ils soupçonnent certains acteurs de chercher à tirer avantage de la nouvelle réglementation pour renforcer leur position sur le marché du transport de sable. Certains transporteurs évoquent même le risque d’une concentration du marché. Des opérateurs étrangers sont notamment mis en cause par certains d’entre eux, qui les accusent de chercher à influencer les décisions publiques. Ces accusations n’ont toutefois pas été étayées dans les éléments recueillis. « Je transporte du sable à Ramena depuis 2019. Cela fait également longtemps que des poids lourds transportant des conteneurs circulent dans cette commune, pas seulement de sable . Pourquoi cette décision intervient-elle seulement maintenant ? », s’interroge Eliazara José Randrianary, actif dans le transport de sable. Le transporteur estime que la limitation actuelle risque de pénaliser les opérateurs qui ont investi dans des véhicules de grande capacité afin de limiter le nombre de rotations et d’éviter une augmentation du prix du sable. Autre conséquence de la mesure, certains transporteurs disent être contraints de chercher de nouvelles zones d’approvisionnement pour charger leur sable. Parmi les localités évoquées figure la commune rurale d’Ambolobozo, située à 60 km d’Antsiranana. Raheriniaina

cm.title: Palmes académiques 2026 : 1 610 dossiers sur la table du Conseil national
cm.description: © DR Le MINESEC tient le mardi 15 septembre 2026 au Distance Learning Centre de Yaoundé, la 12e session du Conseil National d'Attribution des Palmes Académiques. 1 610 dossiers sont en examen pour les grades de Chevalier, Officier et Commandeur, contre 1 566 en 2025. Le mérite enseignant à l'honneur. Le Ministère des Enseignements Secondaires (MINESEC) tient, le mardi 15 septembre 2026 au Distance Learning Centre de Yaoundé, la 12e session du Conseil national d'attribution des distinctions honorifiques académiques. Les travaux sont présidés par le Secrétaire d'État auprès du MINESEC chargé de l'Enseignement Normal, Boniface Bayaola, représentant le Président du Conseil, le Professeur Nalova Lyonga, Ministre des Enseignements Secondaires. À l'ouverture, Boniface Bayaola a appelé les membres du Conseil à conduire les délibérations dans la cordialité, la sérénité, ainsi que dans un esprit de justice et d'équité. Le Directeur des Ressources Humaines du MINESEC, Orock Comfort, a présenté les critères d'éligibilité aux différents grades. Le grade de Chevalier requiert au moins 15 ans d'expérience dans l'enseignement. Pour devenir Officier, il faut avoir été Chevalier pendant au moins cinq ans, tandis que le grade de Commandeur exige 25 ans d'expérience et cinq ans comme Officier. Pour la session 2026, 1 610 dossiers ont été enregistrés, contre 1 566 en 2025. Ils comprennent 1 027 candidatures pour le grade de Chevalier, 223 pour Officier et 360 pour Commandeur. Le Conseil est chargé de déterminer le nombre de médailles avant la sélection des lauréats, dont les distinctions seront remises le 5 octobre, à l'occasion de la Journée Mondiale de l'Enseignant. Cet article Palmes académiques 2026 : 1 610 dossiers sur la table du Conseil national est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
